assertion_independence: No regression assertion is tautological with its supplied input: phases are persisted production outputs compared with an explicit expected sequence and a separately forced whole-ledger route; counters observe production operations; fixture readback and git HEAD checks are identified as setup controls.

assertion_review.failure_condition: Fixture row count or exact run identities differ from the 2000 records written; these are fixture readback controls, not assertions offered as the optimization guard.
The unchanged whole-ledger route returns no mixed verdicts or differs from the explicit five-section expected sequence.
Snapshot reuse changes persisted request phases relative to the whole-ledger oracle or releases a count other than eight.

Removing ledger_rows=rows reinstates extra loader and document-reader calls; negative.log records four loads and 6000 reader calls, proving the read counter sees the defect; physical-open zero alone is insufficient on a warm memo.
A promotion published after snapshot creation releases its waiters immediately, or a new pass fails to see it, or either pass adds a full-history load.
The controlled merge hook did not first encounter a waiting request, did not put the pending commit at HEAD, or never ran; these assert setup rather than implementation durability.
A mid-pass merge bypasses the per-pass wait verdict, the next pass retains stale state, or either pass performs additional ledger/document reads.
